resources.string: Optional companion for Songport. It connects services that have no open API (YouTube Music, and Amazon Music as an experiment) through the same web interface their players use, so you do not need developer keys. Songport only receives your playlists and tracks; the logins themselves stay in this app.

Amazon Music has no open API either, and its official one is reserved to approved partners. This connector uses the web player\'s interface and is still being completed: sign in, run the connection test, then use the traffic capture so the missing parts can be finished against the real protocol.
Connected as %1$s. Search test returned %2$d tracks.

Use Amazon Music normally here: open Library → Playlists, open one of your playlists, create a playlist, add a song to it, remove it, search for a song. Every call the player makes is written to a file on this phone, without cookies or tokens. Then tap Share and send the file to the developer.

Songport Bridge is an independent, open-source project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Google, YouTube, Amazon or any music service.

It talks to these services through the same interfaces their own web players use, not through an official API. This is against their terms of service. It can stop working at any time, and the service may limit, suspend or close the account you sign in with.

The software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. By continuing you accept that you use it entirely at your own risk and that the developer accepts no responsibility or liability for any consequence, including restrictions on your accounts or loss of data.
Sign in on Spotify\'s own page instead of creating a developer app. The Bridge reuses the web player\'s session and hands Songport a short-lived token; your password and cookies stay here.
Sign in with your Apple ID on music.apple.com instead of paying for the Apple Developer Program. The Bridge reads the web player\'s tokens and hands them to Songport; your password stays here.

This is not an official Google API. Using it is against the YouTube Terms of Service, it can stop working whenever Google changes something, and in the worst case Google could restrict the account you sign in with. Use it at your own risk, ideally with an account you can afford to lose. The official route (your own Google Cloud key) remains available in Songport.
Your session is stored encrypted on this phone only. It is never sent to Songport, to its developer or to anyone else.
